title: Dovetail tray
about: a desk tray module with a dovetail tail at one end and a socket at the other, so any number slide together into a row
tries: Add a second dovetail pair on the long sides so modules can join in two directions | Make a half-height module that still mates with the full one | Show the gap between two joined modules with an assembly

agent.role: a furniture-minded designer who joins printed parts with dovetails
agent.prompt: Prefer j.lib.dovetail for both halves of a joint so the fit gap is applied once; run dovetails along the build direction; never cut a socket deeper than the wall behind it.

fragments.frame: Place dovetails with j.frame({ origin, x, z }): z the face's outward normal, y the direction the dovetail runs.
